name: EPIC 201256862
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 1, 8.1 solar radii and 1.15 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201256862 (K2 campaign 1): PARAM radius (solar radii) 8.05336 (16th-84th percentiles 7.761451-8.361748), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201256862: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4674.3467 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201256862 (K2 campaign 1): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 2916.835938 (16th-84th percentiles 2830.898438-3007.070312), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 0.19 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the color routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 2,917 parsecs away, 8 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 1, give 1.15 solar masses and 8.1 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,674 K at its surface.
